menuItems.name: Lab 01: Setting up Azure and GitHub
menuItems.description: In lab 1, I created an account on Azure and connected my main website to GitHub, inviting collaborators as well.

menuItems.name: Lab 02: Website Resume
menuItems.description: In lab 2, I used HTML and CSS to construct my resume.

menuItems.name: Lab 03: Creating Our Own Website & Information Architecture
menuItems.description: In lab 3, I developed the HTML and CSS files for all main pages such as the landing page, projects page, and extracurriculars page. Additionally, I created an Information Architecture format for this personal website to keep it organized.

menuItems.name: Lab 04: RSS and Atom Feeds
menuItems.description: In lab 4, I created an RSS feed and Atom feed based on five articles from TIME Articles.

menuItems.name: Lab 05: Javascript
menuItems.description: In lab 5, I utilized JavaScript to create a form for user's to fill out their information, stylizing and following through with specific commands.

menuItems.name: Lab 06: jQuery
menuItems.description: In lab 6, I utilized jQuery to stylize specific actions, including toggle text, adding list items, and recoloring list items when clicked on.

menuItems.name: Lab 07: Project Mockups
menuItems.description: In lab 7, my group and I created a project called ScheduleSync and created an IA format and wireframes before our development.

menuItems.name: Lab 08: Utilizing AJAX
menuItems.description: In lab 8, I had to reorganize this project landing page to create a more efficient code. I stored the lab names, links, and descriptions in a JSON file then called that JSON file to a JavaScript file where I used AJAX.

menuItems.name: Lab 09: PHP & MySQL
menuItems.description: In lab 9, I used PHP and MySQL to create tables with data on movies and actors.

menuItems.name: Lab 10: Moving Our Servers to Production
menuItems.description: In lab 10, I finalized our whole website to make it public!

menuItems.name: Final Project: ScheduleSync
menuItems.description: In this group final project, we created a website that allows college students to connect with other students and compare schedules easily and efficiently.
